name: Shiseido Company, Limited
summary: Shiseido Company, Limited produces and sells in Japan and internationally. It offers fragrances, skincare, and makeup products through retail channels. The company also engages in the restaurant and food businesses; and operates beauty salons. In addition, it operates and supports SABFA, a professional hair makeup training school. Further, the company manages childcare facilities. It serves its products under the BAUM, BENEFIQUE, Clé de Peau Beauté, Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare, Drunk Elephant, EFFECTIM, Gallinée, INOUI, IPSA, ISSEY MIYAKE PARFUMS, NARS, narciso rodriguez, Serge Lutens, SHISEIDO, THE GINZA, Tory Burch Beauty, ZADIG&VOLTAIRE, ANESSA, AQUA LABEL, AUPRES, d program, ELIXIR, HAKU, …
